tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The default surface for everything.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Raised or alternate surface: project card bodies, form fields, the footer.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm block for the one invitation on a page (InquiryBanner) and pull quotes. Never a full page.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: text field outlines, secondary button outline. 3:1 on paper and bone in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mark, on paper, bone and sand.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, captions, spec values, on paper, bone and sand.

tokens.name: ink-quiet
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: years, counters, placeholder text. On paper only in light (4.2:1 on bone, use ink-muted there).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Signature colour and the Culture half of the loop. Fills, the mark, display type 24px and up. For small copper text use copper-text.

tokens.name: copper-text
tokens.usage: Copper at text strength: Culture practice tags, small accents in copper. 7.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: on-copper
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a copper fill.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The Systems half of the loop: links, focus ring, text selection, code, Systems practice tags. Readable as text on paper, bone and sand in both themes.

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Text on an indigo fill, such as selected text.

tokens.name: persimmon
tokens.usage: The live moment: on-air dot, event date, the record light. One use per screen. As text only 24px and up in light; small text uses persimmon-text.

tokens.name: persimmon-text
tokens.usage: Persimmon at text strength for small labels such as LIVE and SOLD OUT. 5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: on-persimmon
tokens.usage: Text on a persimmon fill.

tokens.name: available
tokens.usage: Status only: 'Taking projects' and success messages. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 4px, on every interactive element. At least 7:1 on paper and bone.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the homepage line or a case-study title. Scale down with clamp(4rem, 11vw, 10rem). Bold is the point: let it crop at the edge if it has to.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles on Work, About, Contact.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: A small studio for ambitious ideas.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: Brand, film and the app behind it
styles.usage: Sub-sections and card titles at large size.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We help people find the clearest, most memorable expression of what they are building.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a page title. Max 60 characters per line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Session-first sports matchmaking that leads with place, time and skill before messaging.
styles.usage: Running text. Max 68 characters per line.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Brand identity · Digital experience · Film & motion

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and practice tags, always uppercase. The engineering voice of the brand.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Credits, metadata, units and measurements in SpecSheet.

spacing.note: A 4px base. The page gutter is fluid: clamp(1.25rem, 4.6vw, 4.75rem).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to tag text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and chips; gap between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones; minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading to body block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Breathing room above and below a display-xl line.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photography and video. Images are never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Project cards and form fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large blocks: InquiryBanner, feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-section
tokens.usage: Top corners of a full-width section that slides over the one before (the footer). Top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, practice tags, the cursor ring.

shadow.note: Endlls separates with hairlines and colour blocks, not shadows. The one shadow is the indigo glow for a hovered Systems element.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for every surface.

tokens.name: glow-indigo
tokens.usage: Hover lift on a project card. Nothing else.
